scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @charitychain/backend" "npm run dev -w @charitychain/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @charitychain/shared && npm run generate -w @charitychain/database && npm run build -w @charitychain/backend && npm run build -w @charitychain/frontend && npm run compile -w @charitychain/blockchain
scripts.test: npm run test -w @charitychain/shared && npm run test -w @charitychain/database && npm run test -w @charitychain/backend && npm run test -w @charitychain/frontend && npm run test -w @charitychain/blockchain
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @charitychain/backend && npm run test:coverage -w @charitychain/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run db:validate && npm run build && npm run test
